Name: Tirhakah, King of Ethiopia
Summary: Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, marched out to fight Sennacherib while the Assyrian threatened Jerusalem, prompting Sennacherib's renewed threats to Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Sennacherib, King of Assyria
LifeLesson: Help from afar still could not save Jerusalem; only the angel of the LORD did.
